stories.title: Rebellen in Ethiopië bezetten drie luchthavens, vrees voor verdere escalatie

en.title: Rebels in Ethiopia occupy three airports, fears of further escalation
en.summary: Rebel forces have seized three airports in Ethiopia. The region has experienced conflict previously, with a war between the Tigray People's Liberation Front and government forces from 2020 to 2022 that resulted in significant civilian casualties.

stories.title: President Iran toont bij VN foto's van oorlogsslachtoffers, delegatie VS vertrekt

en.title: Iran's president shows photos of war casualties at UN, US delegation departs
en.summary: At the United Nations General Assembly, Iran's president described his country as a victim of terrorism over the past seven months and stated Iran only acted in self-defense. The US delegation left the session after the Iranian address, which followed a US president's warning about potentially destroying Iran if peace negotiations fail.

stories.title: Provincie waarschuwt voor olie op Zeeuwse stranden

en.title: Province warns of oil on Zeeland beaches
en.summary: Heavy fuel oil has washed ashore on multiple beaches in the Dutch province of Zeeland. Authorities advise beach visitors to avoid contact with the oil and refrain from swimming in affected areas, while the source of the contamination remains unknown.

stories.title: Provincie Zeeland waarschuwt voor aangespoelde stookolie op stranden

en.title: Province of Zeeland warns of washed-up heavy fuel oil on beaches
en.summary: Heavy fuel oil has been found on several beaches in Zeeland, often mixed with seaweed. Local authorities recommend that beach visitors avoid contact with the oil residue.

stories.title: Geweldsuitbarsting in het noorden van Ethiopië, vrees voor oorlog groeit

en.title: Violence erupts in northern Ethiopia, fears of war grow
en.summary: A violent outbreak has occurred in northern Ethiopia, with concerns about potential escalation to war increasing in the region.

stories.title: Politie zet traangas in bij protest tegen uithuiszetting 87-jarige vrouw in Madrid

en.title: Police use tear gas at protest against eviction of 87-year-old woman in Madrid
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman was evicted from her Madrid home after living there over seventy years due to inability to pay rent. Police deployed tear gas to disperse several hundred protesters who gathered to oppose the eviction.

stories.title: Schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper bewees dat het niet zo moeilijk hoeft te zijn, kinderen aan het lezen krijgen

en.title: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper demonstrated that getting children to read need not be so difficult
en.summary: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper has shown that encouraging children to read does not have to be as challenging as commonly believed.

stories.title: Raad van State wijst bezwaren af: Defensie mag radarstation in Herwijnen bouwen

en.title: Council of State rejects objections: Defense may build radar station in Herwijnen
en.summary: The Netherlands' highest administrative court has dismissed objections from residents and the West Betuwe municipality against a military radar station planned for the village of Herwijnen. The court found the government adequately justified its choice of location.

stories.title: Australische illustrator Terry Denton (De waanzinnige boomhut) overleden

en.title: Australian illustrator Terry Denton (The Crazy Tree House) deceased
en.summary: Australian illustrator Terry Denton has died at age 76. Denton was known worldwide for his illustrations in The Crazy Tree House book series, created with writer Andy Griffiths, and for his own illustrated works.

stories.title: Iraanse president toont foto’s van slachtoffers schoolbombardement, delegatie VS loopt weg

en.title: Iranian president shows photos of victims from school bombardment, US delegation walks away
en.summary: Iran's president presented photographs of casualties from a school bombing while a United States delegation departed from the presentation.

stories.title: Schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper was er oprecht van overtuigd dat kinderen schoonheid verdienen

en.title: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper genuinely believed children deserve beauty
en.summary: Dutch children's author Sjoerd Kuyper, who died at age 74, was known for taking children seriously by centering the childlike perspective in his works, including his acclaimed Robin series.

stories.title: Het zakmes-schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper op 74-jarige leeftijd overleden

en.title: The Pocketknife author Sjoerd Kuyper died at age 74
en.summary: Sjoerd Kuyper, author of The Pocketknife book and film, died at age 74 following a brief illness. He was widely recognized for his children's books, which earned him numerous prizes.
